146	    stack = []
147	    blocks = {name: {} for name in ("section", "item", "gap", "residual")}

150	        key = (key or "").strip()

152	            if key or not stack or stack[-1][0] != kind:
153	                diagnostics.append(_issue(4, key or "$", f"prd.md:{match.start()}", "定位块闭合不匹配或交叉。"))
154	                continue
155	            opened_kind, opened_key, begin, section = stack.pop()
156	            blocks[kind][opened_key] = {"text": text[begin:match.start()], "section": section, "start": begin, "end": match.start()}
157	        else:
158	            valid_parent = not stack if kind == "section" else len(stack) == 1 and stack[0][0] == "section"
159	            if not key or not valid_parent or key in blocks[kind] or any(k == kind and v == key for k, v, *_ in stack):
160	                diagnostics.append(_issue(4, key or "$", f"prd.md:{match.start()}", "定位块缺少身份、重复或嵌套不合法。"))
161	                continue
162	            section = key if kind == "section" else stack[0][1]
163	            stack.append((kind, key, match.end(), section))
164	    for kind, key, *_ in stack:
165	        diagnostics.append(_issue(4, key, "prd.md", f"{kind} 定位块未闭合。"))
